description: Double TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**20 tokens per step and scale MATRIX_LR by 1.2 (0.04 to 0.048).
Set DEPTH=10 with ASPECT_RATIO=64 (640-dim, 5 heads) and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=32 to avoid OOM, keeping the total batch the same via grad accumulation.
Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "L" so every layer uses full-context attention instead of the SSSL sliding-window mix.
Initialize the x0 residual lambdas to 0.2 (from 0.1) and halve their Adam learning rate to 0.25 (scalar_lr * 0.5).
Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the 512-dim model uses 8 heads; n_kv_head and value-embedding dims already follow num_heads.
Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for the Muon optimizer.
Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (hidden = 8/3*n_embd rounded to a multiple of 64, 1344 for 512-dim), with the output projection still zero-initialized and the new matrices covered by Muon.
